text:
Alex Chen: FYI paging loop. Alerts show elevated 95th/99th latency on `embed-search` region-us-west for ~5m, error rate up 2.3%. I started this thread to coordinate comms & handoff.

incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Alert: embed-search latency spike detected. Pagerduty: oncall-ops notified. Incident ID: INC-2005001.

Maya Patel: thanks. oncall-ops, are you able to confirm impact to customers or is this internal retrying?

oncall-ops: Jumping in. seeing spike on GPU host pool gpool-7 (nv4). A subset of requests are timing out at backend inference service before retry. No full region outage.

Samir Gupta: looks like KV cache miss rate increased at ~2005001180, might be a cache eviction followed by regen causing load. I've queued a read-only bypass to test.

Laura Kim: for comms: we should prepare an initial external note (short) and an internal ops update. I'll draft. Want to confirm scope: affected customers are minority on embeddings and any downstream vector search jobs that are latency-sensitive, right?

oncall-ops: yes, approximate impact: ~3% of embeddings requests in us-west, increased tail latency and some ~504s. No data loss.

Alex Chen: good. Drafts below. Please review inline and I'll post to status once we have signoff. Keep messages short.

Alex Chen: INITIAL STATUS PAGE DRAFT:
```
Components: Embeddings API (us-west)
Status: Investigating
Impact: Some customers may experience increased latency and intermittent errors when calling the embeddings endpoint in the us-west region.
What we are doing: Our on-call team is investigating and applying mitigations; retries and fallback routing are being evaluated.
ETA for next update: 15-30 minutes.
```

Maya Patel: concise. Suggest adding: "No changes required to customer code; requests will either succeed or return an error—please retry per your client backoff."

Alex Chen: updated.

Alex Chen: INTERNAL OPS UPDATE DRAFT (for #eng-oncall):
```
Summary: Elevated tail latency (95/99) and increased 504s on embeddings us-west. Root cause suspected: cache eviction cascade on gpool-7 causing regen pressure.
Actions taken: - Isolated gpool-7, re-routed new traffic to gpool-3/gpool-5. - Temporarily increased cache size on affected hosts. - Monitoring ingress and retry rates.
Next steps: - Continue traffic steering for 30m. - Rollback any config when stable. - Postmortem owner: @Samir.
```

Samir Gupta: I can own postmortem. Also recommend we include metric links and relevant traces in the ops note.

Laura Kim: Good. For customer-facing email (only for high SLA customers impacted), I suggest a targeted alert if we see >5% sustained errors. For now stick to status page + support note.

oncall-ops: mitigation in progress: re-route active requests off gpool-7 at 2005001305. Error rate trending down.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] INC-2005001: mitigation applied. Monitoring.

Maya Patel: ok next: copy for a short support message to post in Zendesk thread templates. Keep it actionable.

Alex Chen: SUPPORT TEMPLATE DRAFT:
```
Hi <Customer>,
We're currently investigating intermittent latency and errors impacting embeddings requests in our US-West region. Our engineers have applied routing mitigations and are monitoring. No data loss is expected.
If you are experiencing issues, please include request IDs, timestamps, and example payloads. We will follow up with updates.
Apologies for the inconvenience.
```

Laura Kim: 👍. add estimated next update time placeholder like "Next update within 30 minutes" so support can set expectations.

Alex Chen: done.

oncall-ops: from telemetry at 2005001400 error rate dropped to baseline ~0.3% and 99p latency improving. Will keep observing for 20m.

Samir Gupta: patch to cache config looks stable. I'm running a short soak; if stable I'll remove traffic steering at 2005003600.

Maya Patel: can someone from eng-reliability verify traces look clean before we publish resolved? Prefer two approvals.

Laura Kim: I'll hold the final publish until we have one more signoff from Samir or Alex.

Alex Chen: I'll do a quick pass on the status text. If Samir confirms at 2005003600 we can post resolved. Draft resolved notice below so it's ready:

Alex Chen: RESOLVED STATUS PAGE DRAFT:
```
Components: Embeddings API (us-west)
Status: Operational
Impact: The issue causing increased latency and intermittent errors has been mitigated. Affected requests may have experienced higher latency or transient errors; no customer data was lost.
What we did: Re-routed traffic away from affected GPU pool and increased cache allocation to reduce regeneration pressure.
Time resolved: 2005-03-24T12:00:00Z (approx)
Follow-up: A post-incident review will be posted with details and long-term mitigations.
```

oncall-ops: Samir's confirmation: at 2005003602 traces look normal, can remove steering.

Samir Gupta: confirmed. rolling configs back and will start postmortem doc.

incident-bot: [RESOLVED] INC-2005001: Issue mitigated and service operational.

Laura Kim: publishing resolved note to status page and sending targeted support updates now.

Maya Patel: one follow-up: include an action item to add better cache eviction alarms so we catch this earlier.

Alex Chen: noted. Samir to own the alarm action item in the postmortem.

Laura Kim: thanks all. I'll paste the final status entries into Statuspage and add links to the postmortem once Samir creates it.

Samir Gupta: will create the postmortem doc and link within 48h.

Alex Chen: thanks folks. Close thread once publish done. :thumbsup:
